waivers.reason: The wrappers warn and return 0 for nonpositive mean, degree_of_freedom, or k_stage, but 20.14.2 mandates those arguments be greater than 0. A conforming implementation may reject the nonconforming call without continuing simulation, so the post-diagnostic return and exact diagnostic path lack an independent portable oracle.
Headings, introductory navigation, table title, and column labels provide structure or cross-references but no independently testable SystemVerilog behavior.
